Per-lobe oscillatory power in 2 Hz bins, with a **subject-clustered** bootstrap
(resample whole subjects/patients, never channels). Four extractors are compared
— two *quantities* × two *extraction modes* — all derived from the DuckDB
feature store (no refit):

| | log | linear |
|---|---|---|
| **detrended residual** | `log_psd − ap_log` | `(PSD − PSD_ap) / ΣPSD` |
| **modelled rhythmic** | `peak_log` (periodic model) | `PSD_ap·(10^{peak_log} − 1) / ΣPSD` |

Per @castanheira2025QuantifyingRhythmicArrhythmic the **modelled** rows are the
recommended component-independent rhythmic-power estimate; the detrended residual
is shown for contrast (it conflates rhythmic + aperiodic). Log and linear are
*different units* — shown side by side, not subtracted. The statistical
comparison is **iEEG − HD-EEG** within each extractor (two-sample clustered
bootstrap; difference map below).

```{python}
#| label: imports
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from plotnine import (
    aes,
    element_text,
    facet_grid,
    facet_wrap,
    geom_hline,
    geom_line,
    geom_point,
    geom_ribbon,
    geom_tile,
    geom_vline,
    ggplot,
    labs,
    scale_color_manual,
    scale_fill_gradient2,
    scale_fill_manual,
    theme,
    theme_bw,
)

from pesco import config, store, crossmodal
from pesco.bandpower import LOBE_COLORS

PROJECT_DIR = Path("/Users/daniel/PhD/spectral-comparison/code/")
DB_PATH = PROJECT_DIR / "data/interim/analysis.duckdb"
fig_dir = Path("figures/chapter2")
fig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

BIN_WIDTH = 2.0
B = 2000
LOBE_ORDER = ["Occipital", "Parietal", "Frontal", "Temporal", "Insula"]
EXTRACTORS = {  # column in feat -> display label (ordered)
    "resid_log": "residual · log",
    "resid_lin": "residual · linear",
    "mod_log": "modelled · log",
    "mod_lin": "modelled · linear",
}
EXTRACTOR_ORDER = list(EXTRACTORS.values())
PARAMS_HASH = store.params_hash(
    config.SPECPARAM_SETTINGS, config.FREQ_RANGE, config.SELECTED_MODE
)
```

```{python}
#| label: load-and-extract
con = store.open_db(DB_PATH)
features = store.load(con, "features", PARAMS_HASH)
channels = store.load(con, "channels", PARAMS_HASH)[
    ["channel", "dataset", "subject", "Lobe"]
]
con.close()

feat = features.merge(channels, on=["channel", "dataset"], how="left")
psd = 10.0 ** feat["log_psd"]
psd_ap = 10.0 ** feat["ap_log"]
total = feat.assign(psd=psd).groupby(["dataset", "channel"])["psd"].transform("sum")

feat["resid_log"] = feat["log_psd"] - feat["ap_log"]
feat["resid_lin"] = (psd - psd_ap) / total
feat["mod_log"] = feat["peak_log"]
feat["mod_lin"] = (psd_ap * (10.0 ** feat["peak_log"] - 1.0)) / total
```

```{python}
#| label: binned-matrices
def binned_matrix(feat, dataset, col):
    """channel × bin matrix for one modality/extractor, + subject/lobe per row."""
    sub = feat.loc[feat["dataset"] == dataset, ["channel", "freq", col]]
    wide = sub.pivot(index="channel", columns="freq", values=col).sort_index(axis=1)
    centers, binned = crossmodal.bin_spectrum(
        wide.columns.to_numpy(float), wide.to_numpy(float), BIN_WIDTH
    )
    meta = channels[channels["dataset"] == dataset].set_index("channel")
    return {
        "centers": centers,
        "M": binned,
        "subject": meta.loc[wide.index, "subject"].to_numpy(),
        "lobe": meta.loc[wide.index, "Lobe"].to_numpy(),
    }


mats = {
    (col, ds): binned_matrix(feat, ds, col)
    for col in EXTRACTORS
    for ds in config.DATASETS
}
centers = mats[("resid_log", config.DATASETS[0])]["centers"]
```

```{python}
#| label: bootstrap-state
state_rows = []
for col, label in EXTRACTORS.items():
    for ds in config.DATASETS:
        d = mats[(col, ds)]
        for lobe in LOBE_ORDER:
            rows = d["lobe"] == lobe
            if rows.sum() == 0:
                continue
            point, lo, hi = crossmodal.cluster_bootstrap_cell_means(
                d["M"][rows], d["subject"][rows], B=B, seed=3
            )
            state_rows.append(
                pd.DataFrame(
                    {
                        "extractor": label,
                        "dataset": ds,
                        "Lobe": lobe,
                        "freq": d["centers"],
                        "mean": point,
                        "lo": lo,
                        "hi": hi,
                    }
                )
            )
state = pd.concat(state_rows, ignore_index=True)
state["extractor"] = pd.Categorical(state["extractor"], EXTRACTOR_ORDER, ordered=True)
state["dataset"] = pd.Categorical(state["dataset"], config.DATASETS, ordered=True)
state["Lobe"] = pd.Categorical(state["Lobe"], LOBE_ORDER, ordered=True)
```

```{python}
#| label: cluster-permutation
# Maris–Oostenveld cluster permutation across frequency, per (extractor, lobe).
# Exchangeable unit = subject: per-bin Welch t between iEEG-patient and HD-subject
# means, thresholded into frequency clusters whose mass is tested against a
# subject-relabelling null. Controls family-wise error over the ~40 bins.
perm_rows = []
for col, label in EXTRACTORS.items():
    a, b = mats[(col, "iEEG atlas")], mats[(col, "source HD-EEG")]
    for lobe in LOBE_ORDER:
        ra, rb = a["lobe"] == lobe, b["lobe"] == lobe
        _, A = crossmodal.subject_means(a["M"][ra], a["subject"][ra])
        _, Bm = crossmodal.subject_means(b["M"][rb], b["subject"][rb])
        if A.shape[0] < 2 or Bm.shape[0] < 2:
            continue
        res = crossmodal.cluster_permutation_freq(A, Bm, n_perm=2000, seed=3)
        perm_rows.append(
            pd.DataFrame(
                {
                    "extractor": label,
                    "Lobe": lobe,
                    "freq": a["centers"],
                    "t": res["t_obs"],
                    "significant": res["sig"],
                }
            )
        )
diff = pd.concat(perm_rows, ignore_index=True)
diff["extractor"] = pd.Categorical(diff["extractor"], EXTRACTOR_ORDER, ordered=True)
diff["Lobe"] = pd.Categorical(diff["Lobe"], LOBE_ORDER, ordered=True)
diff.to_csv(
    PROJECT_DIR / "data/interim/specparam_model_selection/"
    "lobe_residual_rhythmic_diff_clusterperm.csv",
    index=False,
)
```

## State spectra — per-lobe mean with subject-clustered 95% CI

```{python}
#| label: fig-state
#| output: true
state_fig = (
    ggplot(state, aes("freq", "mean", color="Lobe", fill="Lobe"))
    + geom_hline(yintercept=0, color="#bbbbbb", size=0.3)
    + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin="lo", ymax="hi"), alpha=0.18, color="none")
    + geom_line(size=0.7)
    + facet_grid("extractor ~ dataset", scales="free_y")
    + scale_color_manual(values=LOBE_COLORS, name="lobe")
    + scale_fill_manual(values=LOBE_COLORS, guide=None)
    + labs(
        x="frequency (Hz, 2-Hz bins)",
        y="oscillatory power (extractor units)",
        title="Per-lobe oscillatory power (subject-clustered bootstrap mean ± 95% CI)",
    )
    + theme_bw()
    + theme(figure_size=(10, 11), plot_title=element_text(size=11))
)
for ext in ("svg", "pdf", "png"):
    state_fig.save(
        fig_dir / f"lobe_oscillatory_state_bootstrap.{ext}",
        width=10, height=11, dpi=150, verbose=False,
    )
state_fig
```

## Cross-modal difference (iEEG − HD-EEG): frequency cluster permutation

```{python}
#| label: fig-diff
#| output: true
lim = float(np.nanpercentile(np.abs(diff["t"]), 99))
diff_fig = (
    ggplot(diff, aes("freq", "Lobe", fill="t"))
    + geom_tile()
    + geom_point(
        diff[diff["significant"]], aes("freq", "Lobe"), size=0.5, color="black"
    )
    + facet_wrap("extractor", ncol=1)
    + scale_fill_gradient2(
        low="#2166AC", mid="white", high="#B2182B",
        midpoint=0, limits=(-lim, lim), name="Welch t\n(iEEG − HD)",
    )
    + labs(
        x="frequency (Hz, 2-Hz bins)",
        y="",
        title="Cross-modal difference (dots: frequency clusters, permutation p < 0.05)",
    )
    + theme_bw()
    + theme(figure_size=(9, 11), plot_title=element_text(size=11))
)
for ext in ("svg", "pdf", "png"):
    diff_fig.save(
        fig_dir / f"lobe_oscillatory_diff_bootstrap.{ext}",
        width=9, height=11, dpi=150, verbose=False,
    )
diff_fig
```
